title: Wrapping tags, centred per line
summary: flex-wrap with justify-content: center keeps every line of tags centred, with gap on both axes.
explanation: flex-wrap: wrap lets tags move onto a new line when the row is full. Each line is then a separate flex line, and justify-content applies to each one.
justify-content: center centres every line, so a short last line does not hug the left edge. gap handles the spacing on both axes, which is why it replaces the old trick of margin on every tag.
tryThis: Remove justify-content: center: the last line sticks to the left.
Change justify-content to space-between: the tags on each line spread to the edges.
Set gap to 4px and see how tight the lines get.
